why: U+200F RIGHT-TO-LEFT MARK is ordinary punctuation inside Arabic or Hebrew text, where it fixes the order of numbers and Latin runs, and a hidden carrier anywhere else. Both sides are docs/ar.md with one RLM before a year; on the pass side the line is Arabic, on the fail side the same line has no right-to-left letter. Remove the line-context exception and the pass side goes red; exempt the mark everywhere and the fail side goes green.
